res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Abilit.AutoCastDelaySeconds: Controls auto cast delay seconds, measured as seconds. For example, changing 0 to 1 makes the affected action wait twice as long between uses.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Abilit.AutoCastHealthThresholdPercent: Controls auto cast health threshold percent, measured as a ratio or multiplier. For example, changing 50 to 100 doubles the configured auto cast health threshold percent.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Abilit.DesignerNotes: Controls designer notes. For example, changing this text changes the name, message, key, or lookup value shown or consumed by the owning system.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Abilit.TargetSelectionStyle: Chooses one eligible Ally or Monster, and can choose the anchor for a target-centered AOE. LowestHealth compares health percentage; Nearest uses gameplay distance; Random chooses any valid candidate.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Abilit.AreaTargetGroup: For AreaOfEffect abilities, controls which side can receive the effect: Allies, Enemies, or Everyone. Ignored by non-AOE abilities.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Abilit.AreaOrigin: For AreaOfEffect abilities, controls where the area is centered. Self centers on the caster; Target centers on a selected ally or monster. Ignored by non-AOE abilities.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Abilit.AreaRadius: Radius of an AreaOfEffect in logical gameplay pixels. AOE abilities require a value greater than zero; Taunt currently uses 140.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Abilit.ComboPointCost: Combo points required and consumed when the ability commits. Sinister Strike uses 5. A value of 0 means the ability does not use combo points.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Abilit.DamageCalculationMode: Defines how DirectDamage calculates requested damage. Fixed uses BaseDamage. BasicAttackMultiplier scales the caster's normal basic attack damage.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Abilit.BasicAttackDamageMultiplier: Multiplier used when DamageCalculationMode is BasicAttackMultiplier. A value of 2.0 means exactly 200% of the caster's current basic attack damage.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Abilit.RangeMode: Defines how target range is evaluated. Fixed uses the authored Range value. BasicAttackRange inherits the caster's real basic-attack reach, including combat spacing, body radii, lunge distance, presentation scale, and melee engagement positioning.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Abilit.DodgeRule: Controls whether the ability uses the defender's resolved Dodge chance or cannot be dodged. Use DefenderDodge for normal offensive attacks/spells/abilities. Use CannotBeDodged for explicit overrides such as Taunt and non-offensive effects such as Heal.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Abilit.SupportRole: Describes how this ability participates in party rescue decisions. None uses only normal automatic-use rules. RecoverAlly prioritizes the pressured ally selected by party support. Peel prioritizes monsters currently pressuring that ally; Taunt, Frost Nova, Fear, and other different effects can all use Peel.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Abilit.SupportPriority: Base score for this ability during party-support decisions. Situational bonuses are added on top of this value. Higher final scores are preferred; exact ties preserve authored ability-list order.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Abilit.SupportPriorityPerThreatAffected: For Peel abilities, adds this much support score for each monster currently pressuring the rescued ally that the ability would actually affect. Raise it to make multi-target peel tools become more valuable as pressure increases.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Abilit.SupportPriorityPerMissingHealthPercent: For RecoverAlly abilities, adds this much support score per missing-health percentage point covered. Single-target recovery uses the rescued ally; AOE recovery sums injured living allies inside the area.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Abilit.AppliedStatusEffect: Reusable CombatStatusEffectDefinition applied when Effect Type is Apply Status Effect. Drag a status resource such as status.core.freeze here. The status defines control behavior; this ability defines duration, targeting, Dodge, cooldown, resource cost, and support intent.

res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/HeroCo.CurrentTargetBonus: Controls current target bonus. For example, changing 35 to 70 doubles this setting's configured contribution to the system.

res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/HeroCo.RequiredSwitchAdvantagePercent: Controls required switch advantage percent, measured as a ratio or multiplier. For example, changing 25 to 50 doubles this setting's configured contribution to the system.

res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Combat.ContentId: Stable ID for this reusable combat status effect, such as status.core.freeze. IDs must use lowercase category.namespace.name format and begin with status.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Combat.DisplayName: Player-facing name used by logs, tooltips, and future status-effect UI.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Combat.Description: Description of what the status represents. Control behavior is authored separately below so identity text never drives gameplay.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Combat.DesignerNotes: Designer-only notes. This field has no gameplay effect.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Combat.PreventsMovement: When enabled, affected actors cannot move through normal combat movement while this status is active. Use for effects such as Freeze or Root.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Combat.PreventsBasicAttacks: When enabled, affected actors cannot begin new basic attacks while this status is active.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Combat.PreventsAbilities: When enabled, affected actors cannot begin new abilities while this status is active.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Combat.InterruptsBasicAttacks: When enabled, a basic attack already in progress is canceled and reset when the status takes control. Requires Prevents Basic Attacks.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Combat.InterruptsAbilities: When enabled, an ability already being cast is canceled and reset without starting its cooldown. Requires Prevents Abilities.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Combat.DisplayAbbreviation: Short label used by the reusable status display, such as FRZ. Leave blank to derive the first three letters from Display Name.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Combat.DisplayColor: Presentation-only tint used for this status in the reusable status display. It does not affect gameplay.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Combat.ForcedMovementMode: Optional forced-movement behavior. Away From Source preserves directional fear; Panic changes direction randomly while contained.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Combat.ForcedMovementSpeedMultiplier: Multiplier on normal move speed while forced movement owns the actor.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Combat.PanicDirectionChangeMinSeconds: Minimum time a Panicked actor keeps one random direction.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Combat.PanicDirectionChangeMaxSeconds: Maximum time a Panicked actor keeps one random direction.
res://Scripts/Content/Definitions/Combat.PanicLeashDistance: Maximum logical-pixel distance a Panicked actor may wander from where its Panic movement began.

res://Controllers/UI/CombatStatusEffectD.StatusOwner: Actor whose runtime CombatStatusEffectState this reusable display presents. Assign the owning HeroActorController or MonsterActorController.
res://Controllers/UI/CombatStatusEffectD.StatusContainer: HBoxContainer that receives one compact label for each active status effect.

res://Scripts/Services/SceneBoundaryServ.SceneRightBoundary: Movable Marker2D defining the right edge for gameplay mechanics that opt into scene containment. It is not a collision wall.
